actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.desc: The corrupted ushabti makes two Ceremonial Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: The corrupted ushabti exhales scarabs in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 25 (10d4) piercing damage and is covered in scarabs. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't covered in scarabs. A creature covered in scarabs takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature, including the covered creature, can take its action to brush the scarabs off the covered creature by succeeding on a DC 15 Dexterity check.

traits.desc: The ushabti regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

traits.desc: The corrupted ushabti is a spirit inhabiting a colony of scarabs around a Humanoid skeleton within funerary wrappings. It can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny scarab and Humanoid bones, and it can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp, except for its Regeneration trait.

ru.description: Средняя нежить, мировоззрение: нейтрально-злое. Класс доспеха: 15 (природный доспех). Хиты: 97 (15к8 + 30). Скорость: ходьба 30 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 17, ЛОВ 14, ТЕЛ 15, ИНТ 6, МУД 10, ХАР 5. Уязвимость к урону: огнём. Сопротивление урону: дробящего, колющего, рубящего. Иммунитет к состояниям: очарование, истощение, испуг, паралич, окаменение, отравление, оглушение. Чувства: тёмное зрение 60 фт., пассивное Восприятие 10. Показатель опасности: 5. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 4, действий: 3.
ru.name: Корруптед Ушабти
